companyName: Centre Hospitalier de l'Université de Montréal (CHUM)
summary: Keep the existing CHUM hospital PPP record deferred and do not publish a replacement cap table. Fresh direct evidence verifies Collectif Santé Montréal S.E.C. / Health Montréal Collective Limited Partnership as the ProjectCo, the original 2011 cap table, Innisfree's current 55% aggregate equity across managed funds, John Laing's current 25%, and AtkinsRéalis' current 10% through 15586925 Canada Inc. It also confirms that BBGI's proposed 25% acquisition was cancelled. No direct source identifies the holder, manager, fund, vehicle or effective date for the residual 10% from Dalkia's original 20%, so ownership cannot reconcile to 100%. Equitix, John Laing Investments Limited and direct KKR ProjectCo attribution remain unsupported.
resolvedFormerBlockers: The direct CHUM contract annex identifies the Québec limited-partnership ProjectCo and verifies its original 1,000-unit structure: Innisfree 300 units, OHL 250, Explore 250 and Dalkia 200.
The current Innisfree health-portfolio table reports that Innisfree-managed funds hold 55% of CHUM equity.
The direct federal notice index records a February 2018 acquisition by Innisfree Canada ISF 2 Limited involving the Explore Health Montreal group and Health Montreal Collective LP.
OHLA's direct completion notice and John Laing's current portfolio page verify the 25% sale to John Laing Health Montreal Limited on 2024-11-28 and the continuing 25% John Laing interest.
AtkinsRéalis' audited 2025 financial statements verify a 10% HMC L.P. interest acquired on 2024-03-04, and Morningstar DBRS identifies 15586925 Canada Inc. as the entering AtkinsRéalis affiliate.
The accessible BBGI RNS copy confirms that the contemplated 25% acquisition did not complete and the purchase process formally ended.
